basic_details.job_title: ASAP Kerala Assistant Engineering Consultant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: KILA - KIIFB PMU has 2 Assistant Engineering Consultant internship vacancies in Trivandrum for B.Tech Civil Engineering graduates, listed by the Additional Skill Acquisition Programme (ASAP) Kerala. The internship runs for 3-9 months with financial benefits of Rs 24,040, and the application fee is Rs. 500 (non-refundable). Applications are made online on the ASAP Kerala careerlink portal, and the last date to apply is 7 December 2026. This is an internship, not a regular post.

vacancy_details.details: The notice lists 2 vacancies for Assistant Engineering Consultant. It prints no category-wise break-up. The reported vacancies are at the sole discretion of the organization providing the internship.

how_to_apply: Visit the application page https://careerlink.asapkerala.gov.in/internships/list/IN26112700201 and submit your application.
Pay the non-refundable application fee of Rs. 500 during the registration process.
After successful registration, you will receive further instructions for the screening process.
The notice does not name any documents to be attached.
important_instructions: The internship does not guarantee a permanent position. It is limited to the period mentioned in the notification. The reported vacancies, final selection and posting orders are at the sole discretion of the organization providing the internship. The application fee of Rs. 500 is non-refundable.

content_sections.heading: KILA-KIIFB PMU Assistant Engineering Consultant at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notice does not specify the age limit.

content_sections.heading: About KILA-KIIFB PMU Internship
content_sections.text: The internship is listed on the ASAP Kerala (Additional Skill Acquisition Programme Kerala) website as one of its internship vacancies in organisations for graduates. The host organisation named in the listing is KILA - KIIFB PMU, and the posting is in Trivandrum.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 2 vacancies for Assistant Engineering Consultant. It prints no category-wise break-up. The reported vacancies are at the sole discretion of the organization providing the internship.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice prints no desirable qualification, experience requirement or age limit.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The notice gives the financial benefits as Rs 24,040. The duration of the internship is 3-9 months. The internship does not guarantee a permanent position and is limited to the specified period mentioned in the notification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KILA-KIIFB PMU Assistant Engineering Consultant
content_sections.text: Visit the application page https://careerlink.asapkerala.gov.in/internships/list/IN26112700201 and submit your application. Pay the non-refundable application fee of Rs. 500 during the registration process. After successful registration, you will receive further instructions for the screening process. The notice does not name any documents to be attached.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Each position has a specific screening process to evaluate candidates' suitability. The screening process may include written tests and interviews. Candidates are evaluated on their performance, and a rank list is published for each position. The notice gives no date for the screening.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The internship does not guarantee a permanent position. It is limited to the period mentioned in the notification. The reported vacancies, final selection and posting orders are at the sole discretion of the organization providing the internship. The application fee of Rs. 500 is non-refundable.
